jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods

• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany

• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)

• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country

• Has a good level of English

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods

• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 

• Average of 12h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)

• Between 5 to 15 stops/day

• Never on weekends or on holidays

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence and code 95

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country

• Has a good level of English

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby + truck cannot be taken home)

Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!

jobs.occupation: Technical Assistant / Junior Technician - 2 Shifts - Bruges
jobs.description:
Have you completed a technical education, but do you not yet have the years of experience many vacancies ask for?

Then we would still like to hear from you!

For an automated production environment in Bruges, we are looking for a Technical Assistant / Junior Technician who wants to further develop within industrial maintenance.

You do not need to know everything from day one. What we do expect is a solid techncial foundation, an interest in machinery and, above all, the motivation to learn.

What will you do?

• Perform preventive maintenance

• Carry out basic technical interventions

• Analyse breakdowns and help solve them

• Check electrical and mechanical components

• Work with motors, sensors and production installations

• Replace or repair technical parts

• Perform small technical repairs and maintenance tasks

• Provide technical support for new machines and workstations

• Identify abnormalities and report them correctly

• Contribute ideas for improvements to machines and installations

During your first months, you will receive intensive guidance from an experienced technician.

• You have completed a full technical education

• For example in electricity, electromechanics, industrial technology or a similiar field

• Good basic knowledge of electricity and/or mechanics

• Willing to work in a 2-shift System

• You speak very good English and are willing to learn Dutch.

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks

• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods

• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe

After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics

• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)

• Can work in a 2-shift system

• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments

• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)

So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.

 

!! Please note: you do NOT qualify if you're not already living in Belgium and don't have legal permission to work in the country !!

jobs.occupation: Technician in day shift - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company

• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations

• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities

• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles

• Supervise external contractors and service providers

You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field

• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics

• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)

• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written

• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the area of Oostkamp or Bruges

Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not obligated, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC... The company can teach you these on the job.

You work on a production line in the cold, warm or expedition department. You fill, garnish or label products and ensure everything runs smoothly with your colleagues. You follow strict hygiene and quality rules. You contribute to a safe and organized workplace.

• Good Dutch or fluent English

• Fast and accurate working style (line work)

• Strong focus on quality and hygiene

• Neat appearance (no gel nails, visible piercings, etc.)

• Comfortable working in cold (0–4°C)

• Team player

• Experience in production is a plus

jobs.occupation: Truck  Driver with   CE License  &  Warehouse Worker (M/F/X)     –    2 shifts     –       Brussels
jobs.description:
We are looking for a versatile CE driver & warehouse worker (M/F/X) to join the team of a well-known employer in Zaventem. In addition to driving the lorry between the two warehouses (distance of approximately 12 kilometres), you will also work as a warehouse worker and be deployed in a multifunctional role.
 

Performing the job correctly contributes to good results and a stronger team. That is why flexibility, eagerness to learn, common sense and stress resistance are essential. Do you have an ETP certificate or a forklift certificate? That is a plus, but not a requirement.

 

• You are stress-resistant, accurate and able to stay focused. 

• You are a team player. 

• You are flexible and motivated. 

• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch is a plus! 

• You can easily travel to work. 

• You have the ability to work in a rotating two-shift system. 

• You have a CE driving licence.

Job Description

What will your day look like?

As a loader/unloader, you play an essential role in the warehouse operations. Your main responsibilities include:

 
• 
 
Loading and unloading trucks

 
 
• 
 
Handling and lifting heavy packages (physical fitness required)

 
 
• 
 
Working in a fast?paced and dynamic environment

 
 
• 
 
Supporting warehouse activities during day shifts and rotating shifts

 

In the long term, you will have the opportunity to learn how to operate a forklift and/or reach truck, offering great potential for growth.

Candidate Profile

Our ideal loader/unloader has:

 
• 
 
Good physical condition

 
 
• 
 
Experience with BT equipment (certificate is a strong plus)

 
 
• 
 
Willingness to work in shifts and occasional night shifts

 
 
• 
 
A hands?on mentality and proactive attitude

 
 
• 
 
Enjoyment in working in a dynamic logistics environment

 
 
• 
 
Fluency in Dutch or English

What does a reachtruckchauffeur do here? You keep goods flowing smoothly. As a reachtruckchauffeur, you move products, load and unload trucks, and prepare orders for shipping.

It’s a bit like being a traffic controller—but inside a warehouse. You’ll also check quality and keep things tidy and safe.

Are you the right reachtruckchauffeur? You have experience, a valid certificate, and feel confident on a reach truck.

As a reachtruckchauffeur, you’re flexible with shifts and communicate in English or Dutch.

You work accurately, safely, and like being part of a team.

As a Team Leader, you are the right-hand person of the Supervisor and lead a team of approximately 12 warehouse operators. You ensure that all rules and procedures related to cleanliness, safety, and quality are followed, and that the warehouse is always maintained to the highest standards.

You work closely alongside your team on the warehouse equipment and are primarily responsible for operational leadership and guidance. You collaborate closely with the Supervisor, who is your direct manager.

What does our ideal Team Leader look like?

As a Team Leader, you are fluent in Dutch and have strong communication skills in English. Knowledge of French is considered an asset. Ideally, you have experience working in a logistics warehouse environment and have already held a supervisory or leadership role.

You are a team player who is accurate, independent, positive-minded, and driven to achieve results. You possess the necessary leadership skills to motivate and guide your team effectively, and you hold a valid forklift or reach truck certificate.

•
